##### ALLIED HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS INC.
##### HOME HEALTH AGENCY


Allied Healthcare Professionals, INC. is a full service skilled home health agency located in
Ventura County, California. Our goal is to meet our patients needs in their home setting, with an
emphasis on safety and preventing hospital re-admission. Allied HCP, INC. upholds the highest level
of patient privacy (HIPPA) and patient rights, while collaborating with our patients, their
families, caregivers and their physicians.



* CHAP Deemed Status               
* Live On-Call 24/7 Staff               
* 4.5 Medicare Star Rating
* Medicare Certified                      
* Bilingual Staff                             
* Wound Care Certified Clinicians
* California Licensed                   
* Quick Intake Response              
* Highly Skilled & Trained Rehab Clinicians




"Putting the Care Back in Health Care."


Our Standard of Care:
* Our clinicians create and implement customized plans of care and exercise programs to fit each
  patient’s individual needs.
* Our clinicians generate measurable goals based on initial and continuous assessments to guarantee
  our patients success.
* Our office staff has a dedicated quality assurance team who ensures regulatory compliance. 
* Our management team complies with all medicare regulations, updates and changes at all times. 
* All staff are kept informed of all Medicare updates and their implications on agency policy.
* Our entire team adheres to all Infection Control Policies, HIPPA compliance and Safety Measures
  for all patients and staff.




##### Our Services

Allied Healthcare Professionals provides the following skilled services:

 
* Skilled Nursing Care
* Physical Therapy
* Occupational Therapy
* Speech Therapy
* Home Health Aide
* Registered Dietitian
* And many other services  [See more >][12]>

##### Additional Services

Allied Healthcare Professionals assist with the following: 
* Community Resources
* Obtaining DME Equipment
* Coordination with: Laboratory Services, Mobile X-rays, G-Tube Maintenance, Specialty Pharmacy
* Call today to see what we can do for you.  [See more >>][13]

##### ALLIED HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS INC.
##### HOME HEALTH AGENCY


Allied Healthcare Professionals, INC. is a full service skilled home health agency located in
Ventura County, California. Our goal is to meet our patients needs in their home setting, with an
emphasis on safety and preventing hospital re-admission. Allied HCP, INC. upholds the highest level
of patient privacy (HIPPA) and patient rights, while collaborating with our patients, their
families, caregivers and their physicians.



* CHAP Deemed Status               
* Live On-Call 24/7 Staff               
* 4.5 Medicare Star Rating
* Medicare Certified                      
* Bilingual Staff                             
* Wound Care Certified Clinicians
* California Licensed                   
* Quick Intake Response              
* Highly Skilled & Trained Rehab Clinicians




"Putting the Care Back in Health Care."


Our Standard of Care:
* Our clinicians create and implement customized plans of care and exercise programs to fit each
  patient’s individual needs.
* Our clinicians generate measurable goals based on initial and continuous assessments to guarantee
  our patients success.
* Our office staff has a dedicated quality assurance team who ensures regulatory compliance. 
* Our management team complies with all medicare regulations, updates and changes at all times. 
* All staff are kept informed of all Medicare updates and their implications on agency policy.
* Our entire team adheres to all Infection Control Policies, HIPPA compliance and Safety Measures
  for all patients and staff.




##### Our Services

Allied Healthcare Professionals provides the following skilled services:

 
* Skilled Nursing Care
* Physical Therapy
* Occupational Therapy
* Speech Therapy
* Home Health Aide
* Registered Dietitian
* And many other services  [See more >][12]>

##### Additional Services

Allied Healthcare Professionals assist with the following: 
* Community Resources
* Obtaining DME Equipment
* Coordination with: Laboratory Services, Mobile X-rays, G-Tube Maintenance, Specialty Pharmacy
* Call today to see what we can do for you.  [See more >>][13]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

vitals monitoring and vision screening

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

is possible in healthcare.

innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

supplier. You’re choosing neighbors and friends who provide outstanding connected care and
high-quality medical products, prioritize clinical excellence, and help you live a more comfortable
life. You’re choosing the feel of a hometown company with all the advantages of a national provider.

Our comprehensive selection of home medical equipment and services means you can rest assured that
we’re ready to meet your needs. We dedicate ourselves to partnering with your medical team and
empowering you to manage your health in the comfort of your own home. At Rotech, we believe
respiratory and medical equipment should improve your life, not limit it.

EMS systems integrators, general aviation, and military users.  We provide service and support to

hydrostatic testing, fire bottle MRO, and oxygen system service, testing, and oxygen cylinder

masks, PMA cylinders, accessories, ground support equipment, and MRO and aftermarket services.

With the Dominion Energy app, logging in is faster and easier than ever by taking advantage of

* Access your home's energy usage information

## Georg Brunstam, 1957-2023

On September 1, HEXPOL’s long-time CEO and President Georg Brunstam suddenly passed away. His
passing is first and foremost a tragedy for his immediate family, but is also a great loss for
HEXPOL as an organization and for the many who were touched by his commitment and leadership, both
on a professional and personal level.

Georg took over as CEO and President of the HEXPOL Group in 2008 after having held leading positions
in companies such as Nolato and the Trelleborg. During the years 2017 to 2020, he assumed the role
of chairman of the board for HEXPOL and then again led the company as CEO and President. Throughout
the years, Georg has created a strong organization within HEXPOL with many highly skilled and
qualified managers.

During George’s time with the company, HEXPOL’s turnover has grown from just below SEK 3 billion to
SEK 22 billion. Today, HEXPOL is a large and well-managed Group, a world leader in polymer compounds
with a globally established manufacturing footprint.

Georg was a highly valued leader and colleague who impressed with his commitment, visionary approach
and impressive business acumen. His strength lay in an unforced and straightforward leadership style
that made everyone feel seen – from the factory floor to the boardroom. Georg was encouraging and
generous with praise and always tried to highlight internal abilities in recruitment.

Georg loved his work and he loved “his” HEXPOL. Colleagues around the world will remember him with
great warmth. His leadership principles and values will continue to characterize the organization
for a long time.

Georg Brunstam

## Georg Brunstam, 1957-2023

On September 1, HEXPOL’s long-time CEO and President Georg Brunstam suddenly passed away. His
passing is first and foremost a tragedy for his immediate family, but is also a great loss for
HEXPOL as an organization and for the many who were touched by his commitment and leadership, both
on a professional and personal level.

Georg took over as CEO and President of the HEXPOL Group in 2008 after having held leading positions
in companies such as Nolato and the Trelleborg. During the years 2017 to 2020, he assumed the role
of chairman of the board for HEXPOL and then again led the company as CEO and President. Throughout
the years, Georg has created a strong organization within HEXPOL with many highly skilled and
qualified managers.

During George’s time with the company, HEXPOL’s turnover has grown from just below SEK 3 billion to
SEK 22 billion. Today, HEXPOL is a large and well-managed Group, a world leader in polymer compounds
with a globally established manufacturing footprint.

Georg was a highly valued leader and colleague who impressed with his commitment, visionary approach
and impressive business acumen. His strength lay in an unforced and straightforward leadership style
that made everyone feel seen – from the factory floor to the boardroom. Georg was encouraging and
generous with praise and always tried to highlight internal abilities in recruitment.

Georg loved his work and he loved “his” HEXPOL. Colleagues around the world will remember him with
great warmth. His leadership principles and values will continue to characterize the organization
for a long time.

We have been in business since 1893 and we are committed to a sustainable future.

We are seeing that customers want to move towards “greener polymers”, and I am convinced that our
know-how and experience to use bio-based and recycled materials, will create advantages for us, our
customers and the environment.

###### MISSION

Lifelink, Inc. is a premier medical supplier in the Philippines providing quality products from the
world’s leading companies and valuable customer service to Philippine hospitals.


 

As the exclusive distributor of quality medical products from the world’s best and trusted medical
companies in the Philippines, we aim to provide products that support healthcare providers and their
patients, as well as, improve medical institutions’ efficiency and cost-reducing measures.


Lifelink’s marketing network covers the National Capital Region, Central Luzon, and Southern Luzon.

prevention, equip surgical and interventional procedures and support the management of diabetes.

## AirLife is Committed to Global Excellence

At AirLife, our ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) priorities are closely aligned with our
business strategy, enabling us to safely and efficiently deliver products to our customers and the
patients they serve, while upholding our commitment to Excellence with Every Breath. ESG serves as a
strategic framework for addressing a broad range of priorities, including our carbon footprint,
workplace culture, and corporate ethics and governance practices.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

# [Oxygen XML Editor 28.1][75]

## The Premier All-In-One XML Editing Suite

Oxygen XML Editor is the premier tool for XML editing, authoring and development. Tailored for
beginners to experts, it is versatile, compatible across platforms, and available as a standalone
app or Eclipse plug-in. Boasting robust support for XML technologies, it offers tools for easy
creation, editing, and publishing. It can be further enhanced with the Oxygen AI Positron Assistant
plugin, introducing AI capabilities for natural language content creation and rewriting while
keeping user control.

[ Oxygen XML Editor is the premier text editor for XML geeks, and an indispensable tool for
O'Reilly's Production group.
My team uses Oxygen XML Editor for everything from simple XML editing to Schema validation and XSLT
transformations. The digital production staff especially loves Oxygen's built-in EPUB support, which
eliminates a great deal of the grunt work that is usually entailed in editing EPUB files. The more
we use Oxygen, the more realize what a powerful tool it can be in digital and XML-based
workflows.][81]
Adam Witwer
Director of Content and Publishing Operations
[O'Reilly Media]

# Features & Technologies

## Intuitive XML Editing Interface

Experience a user-friendly, context-aware [*XML Editor*][82] crafted to accommodate newcomers with
ease while offering powerful productivity features for technical experts, ensuring seamless
navigation and precise content creation.

## Visual Authoring (WYSIWYG)

Edit XML documents in the [*Visual XML Editor*][83], a familiar word-processor-like interface that
hides the underlying complexity, making it easier for teams of all skill levels to contribute.

## Comprehensive XML Validation

Ensure every document meets strict quality standards with [*XML validation*][84] against [*XML
Schema*][85], DTD, [*Relax NG*][86], [*Schematron*][87], and NVDL, all directly supported within the
XML Editor.

## Advanced Schema Visualization

Explore and understand complex data models through diagram-based editors and specialized schema
views, streamlining the creation and maintenance of XML Schemas in the [*XML Schema Editor*][88].

## Single-Source Publishing

Convert your validated XML content into multiple outputs, such as HTML5, PDF, EPUB, and more,
directly from the XML Editor using preconfigured or custom publishing scenarios.

## DITA and Structured Authoring

Leverage built-in frameworks like [*DITA*][89], DocBook, [*TEI*][90], JATS, [*XHTML*][91], and
others to produce structured content with ease and consistency.

## XSLT Editing and Debugging

Utilize the XML Editor's integrated [*XSLT*][92] tools to edit, validate, debug, profile, and
transform XML documents with support for all XSLT versions.

## XQuery Execution and Profiling

Write, validate, debug, and run [*XQuery*][93] expressions for complex data manipulations, profiling
performance and ensuring efficient data retrieval, and seamlessly execute queries against [*XML
Databases*][94].

## XPath Evaluation

Execute [*XPath*][95] queries directly within the XPath toolbar or using the [*XPath Builder*][96]
view to quickly locate nodes, filter data, and analyze XML documents.

## AI-Enhanced Editing

Leverage integrated [Oxygen AI Positron Assistant][97] with RAG for more meaningful responses. From
improving existing content and proposing new text to handling translations and refining your
documents, the AI assistant enhances productivity and content quality.

## JSON and YAML Support

Convert, edit, and validate [JSON][98] and [YAML][99] with integrated [JSON Schema][100] support to
ensure compliance and maintain a unified approach to managing diverse structured data formats.

## Collaboration and Review

Facilitate seamless collaboration among multiple stakeholders with in-context commenting and change
tracking, enhancing the editorial workflow. Utilize the powerful [*XML Diff and Merge*][101] tool to
efficiently examine and merge differences.

## Integration with Oxygen Tools

Integrate the XML Editor features into CI environments via [Scripting][102] or [Publishing
Engine][103]. Connect with [Content Fusion][104] for collaborative reviews and integrate
[Feedback][105] to gather user comments on published content.

## Extensibility and Customization

Adapt the XML Editor to your unique workflows with customizable frameworks, [plugins][106] (such as
[Batch Converter][107], [Git Client][108], and many others), and an extensive API for integrating
third-party tools.

## Cross-Platform Availability

Use the XML Editor on Windows, macOS, or Linux, as a standalone desktop application or integrated
into Eclipse, ensuring flexibility across different environments.

# [Oxygen XML Editor 28.1][75]

## The Premier All-In-One XML Editing Suite

Oxygen XML Editor is the premier tool for XML editing, authoring and development. Tailored for
beginners to experts, it is versatile, compatible across platforms, and available as a standalone
app or Eclipse plug-in. Boasting robust support for XML technologies, it offers tools for easy
creation, editing, and publishing. It can be further enhanced with the Oxygen AI Positron Assistant
plugin, introducing AI capabilities for natural language content creation and rewriting while
keeping user control.

# Features & Technologies

## Intuitive XML Editing Interface

Experience a user-friendly, context-aware [*XML Editor*][82] crafted to accommodate newcomers with
ease while offering powerful productivity features for technical experts, ensuring seamless
navigation and precise content creation.

## Visual Authoring (WYSIWYG)

Edit XML documents in the [*Visual XML Editor*][83], a familiar word-processor-like interface that
hides the underlying complexity, making it easier for teams of all skill levels to contribute.

## Comprehensive XML Validation

Ensure every document meets strict quality standards with [*XML validation*][84] against [*XML
Schema*][85], DTD, [*Relax NG*][86], [*Schematron*][87], and NVDL, all directly supported within the
XML Editor.

## Advanced Schema Visualization

Explore and understand complex data models through diagram-based editors and specialized schema
views, streamlining the creation and maintenance of XML Schemas in the [*XML Schema Editor*][88].

## Single-Source Publishing

Convert your validated XML content into multiple outputs, such as HTML5, PDF, EPUB, and more,
directly from the XML Editor using preconfigured or custom publishing scenarios.

## DITA and Structured Authoring

Leverage built-in frameworks like [*DITA*][89], DocBook, [*TEI*][90], JATS, [*XHTML*][91], and
others to produce structured content with ease and consistency.

## XSLT Editing and Debugging

Utilize the XML Editor's integrated [*XSLT*][92] tools to edit, validate, debug, profile, and
transform XML documents with support for all XSLT versions.

## XQuery Execution and Profiling

Write, validate, debug, and run [*XQuery*][93] expressions for complex data manipulations, profiling
performance and ensuring efficient data retrieval, and seamlessly execute queries against [*XML
Databases*][94].

## XPath Evaluation

Execute [*XPath*][95] queries directly within the XPath toolbar or using the [*XPath Builder*][96]
view to quickly locate nodes, filter data, and analyze XML documents.

## AI-Enhanced Editing

Leverage integrated [Oxygen AI Positron Assistant][97] with RAG for more meaningful responses. From
improving existing content and proposing new text to handling translations and refining your
documents, the AI assistant enhances productivity and content quality.

## JSON and YAML Support

Convert, edit, and validate [JSON][98] and [YAML][99] with integrated [JSON Schema][100] support to
ensure compliance and maintain a unified approach to managing diverse structured data formats.

## Collaboration and Review

Facilitate seamless collaboration among multiple stakeholders with in-context commenting and change
tracking, enhancing the editorial workflow. Utilize the powerful [*XML Diff and Merge*][101] tool to
efficiently examine and merge differences.

## Integration with Oxygen Tools

Integrate the XML Editor features into CI environments via [Scripting][102] or [Publishing
Engine][103]. Connect with [Content Fusion][104] for collaborative reviews and integrate
[Feedback][105] to gather user comments on published content.

## Extensibility and Customization

Adapt the XML Editor to your unique workflows with customizable frameworks, [plugins][106] (such as
[Batch Converter][107], [Git Client][108], and many others), and an extensive API for integrating
third-party tools.

## Cross-Platform Availability

Use the XML Editor on Windows, macOS, or Linux, as a standalone desktop application or integrated
into Eclipse, ensuring flexibility across different environments.
